run_multi_turn_question_single: run the multi_turn_question sgl function with two questions and print the generated answers
run_multi_turn_question_batch: run the multi_turn_question sgl function with a batch of question pairs and collect results
define_multi_turn_question_function: define an sgl.function that builds a multi-turn conversation with system, user, and assistant messages
set_openai_backend: set the default sgl backend to OpenAI with the o1 model
generate_multiple_answers: generate two parallel answer candidates using sgl.gen with n=2 and max_tokens=1024
